newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 6 OF JANUARY 10, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 6 OF JANUARY 10, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

COMMISSION DECISION of 17 December 1996 establishing the list of third countries fulfilling the equivalence conditions for the production and placing on the market of bivalve molluscs, echinoderms, tunicates and marine gastropods (Text with EEA relevance) (97/20/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 16 December 1996 approving the technical action plan 1996/97 for the improvement of agricultural statistics (Text with EEA relevance) (97/19/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 16 December 1996 approving the measures to be implemented as regards bovine spongiform encephalopathy in France (Text with EEA relevance) (97/18/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 30 July 1996 concerning aid granted to Santana Motor SA (Only the Spanish text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) (97/17/EC)
COUNCIL DECISION of 20 December 1996 setting up an Employment and Labour Market Committee (97/16/EC)
COUNCIL DECISION of 9 December 1996 on a third multiannual programme for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the European Union (1997 to 2000) (97/15/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 33/97 of 9 January 1997 fixing the export refunds on cereals and on wheat or rye flour, groats and meal
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 32/97 of 9 January 1997 fixing the export refunds on malt
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 31/97 of 9 January 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 30/97 of 9 January 1997 on the issue of import licences for garlic originating in China
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 29/97 of 9 January 1997 laying down derogations in the beef and veal sector as a result of certain veterinary measures

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 28/97 of 9 January 1997 laying down detailed rules for implementation of the specific measures for the supply of certain vegetable oils for the processing industry in the French overseas departments and assessing supply requirements
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 27/97 of 9 January 1997 fixing export refunds on fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 26/97 of 9 January 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 2190/96 as regards systems A1 and B for issuing export licences in the fruit and vegetables sector

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 25/97 of 20 December 1996 amending for the fourth time Regulation (EC) No 3699/93 laying down criteria and arrangements regarding Community structural assistance in the fisheries and aquaculture sector and for processing and marketing of its products
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 24/97 of 20 December 1996 repealing Regulation (EEC) No 1729/76 concerning the communication of information on the state of the Community's energy supplies
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 23/97 of 20 December 1996 on statistics on the level and structure of labour costs END OF DOCUMENT.
